title: Large-Scale Campaign Breaches Enterprise Firewalls and VPNs
excerpt: Cybersecurity researchers reveal a major campaign targeting network edge devices, compromising over 70,000 credentials worldwide.
body_html:
Security researchers have uncovered a widespread cyber attack targeting exposed network edge devices, including Fortinet FortiGate and Palo Alto Networks GlobalProtect firewalls.

The large-scale campaign has resulted in the exposure of more than 70,000 credentials. Investigation artifacts reveal that the threat actors successfully gained access to numerous organizations globally.

Following the initial breaches, the operators attempted to further compromise some of the targeted victims. Further details regarding the extent of the intrusions and the identity of the attackers remain under review as investigations continue.
